name: Confluent Cloud Metrics
description: Ingest Confluent Cloud metrics via the CC Metrics API into Dynatrace using ActiveGate or custom extension.
note: Configure as an ActiveGate extension or use the Dynatrace API v2 metrics ingest endpoint ({ENV_URL}/api/v2/metrics/ingest) to push metrics from a collector script. See https://docs.confluent.io/cloud/current/monitoring/metrics-api.html for CC Metrics API reference.
